results.name: Notification body is an array instead of an object
results.constraint: The request body must be a JSON object conforming to the NotificationData schema ($ref: '#/components/schemas/NotificationData').

results.name: NFStatusNotify with non-JSON Content-Type
results.constraint: The request body content type must be 'application/json'.

results.name: Notification missing required 'event' and 'nfInstanceUri'
results.constraint: The NotificationData object MUST include the properties 'event' and 'nfInstanceUri'.

results.name: Notification with invalid event value
results.constraint: The 'event' property must be one of the NotificationEventType values: NF_REGISTERED, NF_DEREGISTERED, NF_PROFILE_CHANGED, or SHARED_DATA_CHANGED.

results.name: NF_PROFILE_CHANGED missing profile fields
results.constraint: If 'event' is 'NF_PROFILE_CHANGED', then at least one of 'nfProfile', 'profileChanges', or 'completeNfProfile' must be present in the NotificationData object.

results.name: NF_REGISTERED event without nfProfile or completeNfProfile
results.constraint: If 'event' is 'NF_REGISTERED', then at least one of 'nfProfile' or 'completeNfProfile' must be present in the NotificationData object.

results.name: SHARED_DATA_CHANGED event missing sharedDataChanges
results.constraint: If 'event' is 'SHARED_DATA_CHANGED', then 'sharedDataChanges' must be present in the NotificationData object.

results.name: ProfileChanges present but empty array
results.constraint: When present, 'profileChanges' must be an array with at least one item and each item must conform to ChangeItem ($ref: 'TS29571_CommonData.yaml#/components/schemas/ChangeItem').

results.name: Empty sharedDataChanges array in NFStatusNotify
results.constraint: When present, 'sharedDataChanges' must be an array with at least one item and each item must conform to ChangeItem ($ref: 'TS29571_CommonData.yaml#/components/schemas/ChangeItem').

results.name: NFStatusNotify with non-conforming nfProfile (missing nfType)
results.constraint: If 'nfProfile' is present, it must conform to NFProfile ($ref: '#/components/schemas/NFProfile').

results.name: Notification includes prohibited allowedNfTypes in nfProfile.nfServices
results.constraint: When 'nfProfile' is included in a notification, the nfProfile object and any NFService objects contained in nfProfile.nfServices (array items) or nfProfile.nfServiceList (additionalProperties) must not include the properties allowedPlmns, allowedSnpns, allowedNfTypes, allowedNfDomains, or allowedNssais.

results.name: Invalid Content-Encoding header type in NFStatusNotify callback
results.constraint: The callback request may include a 'Content-Encoding' header of type string (Content-Encoding, described in IETF RFC 9110).
